review_scope: Complete 40-unit Chinese–English alignment read including the full eight-row table, title/deck, returned open tasks and self-questioning close. Four local repairs; complete original English retained elsewhere.

changes.before: What this series actually delivers is a set of things that need never have been said, and had to be said because they were said in front of someone else. Not one of them was learned from those others. Every one was forced out by their position.
changes.after: What this series actually delivers is a set of things that would not otherwise have needed to be said, but had to be articulated in confronting other positions. Not one of them was learned from those others. Every one was forced out by their position.
changes.reason: Restore the cause of articulation: comparison with others forces these statements out, not the tautology that saying them required saying them.

changes.before: Kant, Arendt, Machiavelli and SAE each supply one mechanism for a means reworks the party that wields it, and the four do not contain one another. What setting them side by side reveals is a specific blind spot: §12 binds the disqualification of deception to the information gap, so an arrangement conducted openly, with the executor fully informed, in which a person's standing as an end is nonetheless cancelled, draws no verdict from it.
changes.after: Kant, Arendt, Machiavelli and SAE each supply one mechanism for a means reworks the party that wields it, and the four do not contain one another. What setting them side by side reveals is a specific blind spot: §12 binds the disqualification of deception to the information gap, so an arrangement conducted openly, with the executor fully informed, in which a person's position as a subject is nonetheless cancelled, draws no verdict from it.
changes.reason: Keep 主体位置 distinct from 目的位置; the adjacent argument connects them without making them identical terms.

changes.before: The discipline a different thought is not written as a correction previously had a posture and no form. And the consequence of having no form is observable: one and the same divergence will slide, as the prose requires, toward whichever type most favours one's own side. Four types on the relation axis: not covered; cross-domain non-transferable; ground conflict; internal failure. One axis for argument: sufficient or not — subdivided into a missing premise, a concept bearing more than it can, a failed analogy, evidence pointing the other way, over-generalisation, and inferring does not exist from not found.
changes.after: The discipline a difference in thought is not presented as a verdict of right and wrong previously had a posture and no form. And the consequence of having no form is observable: one and the same divergence will slide, as the prose requires, toward whichever type most favours one's own side. Four types on the relation axis: not covered; cross-domain non-transferable; ground conflict; internal failure. One axis for argument: sufficient or not — subdivided into a missing premise, a concept bearing more than it can, a failed analogy, evidence pointing the other way, over-generalisation, and inferring does not exist from not found.
changes.reason: Restore the discipline about right/wrong judgments rather than narrow it to editorial correction.

changes.before: A framework that requires cannot-not be questioned must be the first thing questioned. Each volume therefore states in its body its own domain, the evidential status of its sources, and what it does not claim: which proposition holds only over the passages examined; which is a proposition awaiting verification; which can record only nothing found and cannot issue a certificate; which step is interpretation rather than quotation; and where a primary source could not be obtained, so that the associated judgement has been reduced.
changes.after: A framework that requires claims of necessity to be questioned must itself be the first to face questioning. Each volume therefore states in its body its own domain, the evidential status of its sources, and what it does not claim: which proposition holds only over the passages examined; which is a proposition awaiting verification; which can record only nothing found and cannot issue a certificate; which step is interpretation rather than quotation; and where a primary source could not be obtained, so that the associated judgement has been reduced.
changes.reason: Repair the ambiguous negative cluster and retain the requirement that the framework apply its questioning discipline to itself.
